sql: SELECT country, COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers GROUP BY country
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T1.orderNumber = T2.orderNumber WHERE T1.quantityOrdered * T1.priceEach > 4000 AND T2.status = 'Cancelled'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T1.orderNumber = T2.orderNumber WHERE T1.quantityOrdered < 30 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.orderDate) = '2003'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE creditLimit <= 100000 AND customerNumber IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM payments WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', paymentDate) = '2004')), T1.customerName FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN payments AS T2 ON T1.customerNumber = T2.customerNumber WHERE T1.creditLimit <= 100000 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.paymentDate) = '2004' GROUP BY T1.customerNumber, T1.customerName ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.customerName, c.contactFirstName, c.contactLastName, SUM(p.amount) FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber=e.employeeNumber JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode=o.officeCode JOIN payments p ON p.customerNumber=c.customerNumber WHERE o.city='Tokyo' AND e.reportsTo=1056 GROUP BY c.customerNumber ORDER BY MAX(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.productName FROM products T1 JOIN orderdetails T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode WHERE T1.productScale='1:18' AND T1.productLine='Classic Cars' GROUP BY T1.productName ORDER BY SUM(T2.quantityOrdered) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE c.country = 'USA'
SELECT COUNT(T1.productCode) FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode WHERE T2.MSRP - T2.buyPrice > 100
SELECT DISTINCT c.customerName FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE p.amount > 50000
SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber=c.customerNumber WHERE c.creditLimit=0 AND STRFTIME('%Y', p.paymentDate)='2003'
SELECT e.email FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode=o.officeCode WHERE o.city='Sydney' AND e.jobTitle LIKE '%Sales Manager%'
SELECT COUNT(creditLimit) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Australia' AND creditLimit < 220000
SELECT e.email, e.employeeNumber FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode WHERE o.country = 'USA' AND o.state = 'CA'
SELECT customerNumber FROM payments ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customerNumber FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber=c.customerNumber WHERE c.country='France' AND o.status='Shipped' GROUP BY c.customerNumber HAVING COUNT(*)=2)
SELECT MAX(quantityOrdered * priceEach) - AVG(priceEach) FROM orderdetails WHERE productCode IN (SELECT productCode FROM products WHERE productLine = 'Planes')

SELECT SUM(od.priceEach - p.buyPrice) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE c.country = 'USA' AND o.orderDate BETWEEN '2003-01-06' AND '2005-05-09'
SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE contactLastName LIKE 'M%' AND country <> 'Germany'

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T1.reportsTo FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.employeeNumber = T2.salesRepEmployeeNumber INNER JOIN payments AS T3 ON T2.customerNumber = T3.customerNumber ORDER BY T3.amount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(amount) FROM payments WHERE paymentDate BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2004-06-30'
SELECT T1.reportsTo FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.employeeNumber = T2.salesRepEmployeeNumber WHERE T2.country = 'France'

SELECT p.productName, od.quantityOrdered*od.priceEach a FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode=p.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber=o.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber=c.customerNumber JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber=e.employeeNumber JOIN offices f ON e.officeCode=f.officeCode WHERE f.city='Boston' AND e.jobTitle='Sales Rep' ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT o.addressLine1, o.addressLine2 FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber=e.employeeNumber JOIN offices o ON o.officeCode=e.officeCode WHERE c.city = 'NYC'
SELECT c.addressLine1, c.addressLine2 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE o.orderNumber = 10383
SELECT e.email FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber WHERE c.customerName = 'Dragon Souveniers, Ltd.'
SELECT p.amount FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber=c.customerNumber WHERE c.customerName = 'Petit Auto' AND p.paymentDate='2004-08-09'
SELECT (T1.MSRP - T2.priceEach) / T1.MSRP FROM products T1 JOIN orderdetails T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode WHERE T2.productCode = 'S18_3482' AND T2.orderNumber = 10108
SELECT c.customerName FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber WHERE e.firstName = 'Steve' AND e.lastName = 'Patterson'

SELECT SUM(od.quantityOrdered), SUM(od.quantityOrdered*od.priceEach)/SUM(od.quantityOrdered) FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode=od.productCode WHERE p.productName='18th Century Vintage Horse Carriage'
SELECT T2.addressLine1, T2.addressLine2 FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode WHERE T1.jobTitle = 'President'
SELECT o.shippedDate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber=c.customerNumber WHERE c.customerName='Cruz & Sons Co.' AND o.orderDate='2003-03-03'

SELECT p.productName FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber=o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber=od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON p.productCode=od.productCode WHERE c.customerName='Cruz & Sons Co.' AND o.orderDate='2003-03-03'

SELECT COUNT(T2.customerNumber) FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.orderNumber = T2.orderNumber WHERE T1.productCode IN (SELECT productCode FROM products WHERE productName = '1957 Chevy Pickup')

SELECT t3.firstName, t3.lastName FROM orders AS t1 INNER JOIN customers AS t2 ON t1.customerNumber = t2.customerNumber INNER JOIN employees AS t3 ON t2.salesRepEmployeeNumber = t3.employeeNumber WHERE t1.status = 'Disputed'
SELECT contactFirstName, contactLastName FROM customers WHERE salesRepEmployeeNumber=1370 ORDER BY creditLimit DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT t1.customerName FROM customers t1 JOIN orders t2 ON t1.customerNumber = t2.customerNumber WHERE t2.status = 'Disputed'

SELECT p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) q FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber=od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON p.productCode=od.productCode WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',o.orderDate)='2003' GROUP BY p.productName ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT t1.productName FROM products AS t1 INNER JOIN orderdetails AS t2 ON t1.productCode = t2.productCode ORDER BY t2.priceEach DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT name FROM course WHERE name IN ('Intro to BlockChain', 'Computer Network') ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA T1 JOIN prof T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id WHERE T2.first_name = 'Sauveur' AND T2.last_name = 'Skyme'
SELECT COUNT(prof_id) FROM prof WHERE popularity > (SELECT popularity FROM prof WHERE first_name = 'Zhihua' AND last_name = 'Zhou')
SELECT name FROM course WHERE credit < (SELECT credit FROM course WHERE name = 'Machine Learning Theory')
SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student T1 INNER JOIN RA T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.capability = 5

SELECT s.f_name, s.l_name FROM student s JOIN registration r ON s.student_id=r.student_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE c.name='Machine Learning Theory' AND ((s.f_name='Willie' AND s.l_name='Rechert') OR (s.f_name='Laughton' AND s.l_name='Antonio')) ORDER BY r.sat DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name FROM prof p JOIN RA r ON p.prof_id=r.prof_id JOIN student s ON s.student_id=r.student_id WHERE s.f_name='Willie' AND s.l_name='Rechert'
SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM student WHERE type = 'RPG'

SELECT SUM(T3.gpa) / COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN prof AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T1.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T2.first_name = 'Ogdon' AND T2.last_name = 'Zywicki'
SELECT f_name, l_name FROM student WHERE gpa = (SELECT MAX(gpa) FROM student)
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name FROM prof p JOIN RA r ON p.prof_id=r.prof_id JOIN student s ON s.student_id=r.student_id WHERE s.f_name='Oliy' AND s.l_name='Spratling'

SELECT CASE r.grade WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS result FROM registration r JOIN student s ON r.student_id=s.student_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE s.f_name='Rik' AND s.l_name='Unsworth' AND c.name='Computer Network'
SELECT s.phone_number FROM student s JOIN registration r ON s.student_id=r.student_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE c.name='Intro to BlockChain' AND r.grade='A'
SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM student WHERE type = 'RPG'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.grade='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(r.student_id) FROM registration r JOIN course c ON r.course_id=c.course_id WHERE c.name='Computer Network'

SELECT first_name, last_name FROM prof WHERE graduate_from IN ('Brown University', 'Columbia University', 'Cornell University', 'Dartmouth College', 'Harvard University', 'Princeton University', 'University of Pennsylvania', 'Yale University')
SELECT prof_id, student_id FROM RA WHERE capability = (SELECT MIN(capability) FROM RA)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM prof
SELECT s.f_name, s.l_name, r.capability, s.gpa FROM prof p JOIN RA r ON p.prof_id = r.prof_id JOIN student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE p.first_name = 'Merwyn' AND p.last_name = 'Conkay'
SELECT T3.f_name, T3.l_name, T2.capability FROM prof T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id JOIN student T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T1.graduate_from = 'University of Washington'
SELECT T2.popularity FROM RA T1 JOIN prof T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id WHERE T1.capability=(SELECT MAX(capability) FROM RA) GROUP BY T1.prof_id ORDER BY COUNT(T1.student_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT course_id, student_id FROM registration WHERE grade IS NULL OR grade = ''
SELECT T1.capability FROM RA T1 JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.type = 'RPG' AND T2.intelligence >= 4
SELECT T1.name FROM course T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id WHERE T2.grade = 'D'
SELECT CAST(SUM(sat) AS REAL) / COUNT(course_id) FROM registration WHERE grade = 'B'
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA T1 JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id WHERE T1.salary='low' AND T2.gpa=3.5
SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name, T3.name FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T1.intelligence = 5 AND T1.gpa < 3
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM registration T1 JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id WHERE T1.grade='B' AND T2.intelligence=3

SELECT c.name, c.credit FROM prof p JOIN RA r ON r.prof_id=p.prof_id JOIN registration g ON g.student_id=r.student_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id=g.course_id WHERE p.gender='Female' AND p.teachingability=(SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof WHERE gender='Female')
SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.capability) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA T1 JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.gpa < 2.5
SELECT T2.f_name, T2.l_name, T1.capability FROM RA T1 INNER JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN registration T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T3.grade IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T3.name='Statistical learning' AND T2.sat=4 AND T1.gpa=3.8
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T3.diff=3 AND T1.intelligence=2

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.type = 'UG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.type = 'RPG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.capability < 3
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA T1 JOIN prof T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id WHERE T1.salary='high' AND T2.teachingability=(SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof)
SELECT firstName, lastName FROM Master WHERE birthYear = 1990 AND birthCountry != 'USA'
SELECT firstName, lastName, deathYear - birthYear FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT AVG(weight) FROM Master WHERE height > 72
SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.lgID IN ('PCHA','NHL') GROUP BY T1.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.lgID)=2
SELECT nameGiven, firstNHL, firstWHA FROM Master WHERE firstNHL IS NOT NULL AND firstWHA IS NOT NULL

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year, AVG(T2.Min) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = (SELECT playerID FROM Goalies GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY COUNT(playerID) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year
SELECT nameNick, lastNHL FROM Master WHERE height IS NOT NULL AND height != '' ORDER BY CAST(height AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T2.nameGiven, T3.name, T3.year FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T2.coachID = T1.coachID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.year = T3.year AND T1.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T2.playerID IS NOT NULL AND T2.coachID IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT M.firstName, M.lastName, T.name FROM Master M JOIN Goalies G ON M.playerID=G.playerID JOIN Teams T ON G.year=T.year AND G.tmID=T.tmID WHERE M.birthCountry='Canada' AND M.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND M.pos='G'
SELECT COUNT(year) FROM CombinedShutouts WHERE year = 1977 AND `R/P` = 'R'
SELECT T1.nameGiven, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL)/SUM(T2.GP) FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID='aebisda01' GROUP BY T1.nameGiven
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM AwardsPlayers WHERE pos = 'G' AND year = 1983
SELECT DISTINCT T2.award FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.birthYear = '1952'
SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM Goalies WHERE year = 2005 AND ENG IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(T2.coachID) FROM Master T1 JOIN Coaches T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID WHERE T2.w>30 AND T1.birthCountry='USA'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.birthCity FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1970
SELECT T1.firstName FROM Master T1 INNER JOIN HOF T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID WHERE T1.shootCatch IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.award='All-Rookie' AND T1.birthCity='Toronto'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.award='All-Rookie' AND T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.coachID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID WHERE T2.year=1940 AND T1.birthCountry='Toronto'
SELECT m.birthYear FROM Master m JOIN AwardsPlayers a ON m.playerID=a.playerID GROUP BY m.birthYear ORDER BY COUNT(a.award) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT M.nameNick FROM Master M JOIN AwardsPlayers A ON M.playerID=A.playerID WHERE A.award='All-Rookie' AND M.birthMon='3'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.deathState='MA'
SELECT m.birthCountry FROM Master m JOIN AwardsPlayers a ON m.playerID=a.playerID GROUP BY m.playerID ORDER BY COUNT(a.award) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT W FROM Goalies WHERE playerID='vanbijo01' AND year=1990
SELECT SUM(c.w) FROM AwardsCoaches a JOIN Coaches c ON a.coachID=c.coachID AND c.year=1933 WHERE a.award='Second Team All-Star' AND a.year=1933
SELECT m.shootCatch FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON g.playerID=m.playerID WHERE g.year=2010 ORDER BY CAST(g.SHO AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.year=2002 AND CAST(T2.GA AS INTEGER)>150 ORDER BY CAST(T1.birthYear AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(T1.birthMon AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(T1.birthDay AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID='NJD' GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.SA - T2.GA) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT m.birthCountry, m.birthState, m.birthCity FROM Coaches c JOIN Master m ON m.coachID=c.coachID WHERE c.year=1998 AND c.notes='co-coach with Dave Lewis'
SELECT GP FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID='broadpu01' AND year=1922

WITH t AS (SELECT T2.name, SUM(CAST(T1.PostENG AS INT)) s FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T1.year=2010 GROUP BY T2.name) SELECT name FROM t WHERE s=(SELECT MAX(s) FROM t)
SELECT G FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID='dyeba01' AND year=1921
SELECT DISTINCT pos FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID='hartgi01'
SELECT BenchMinor, name FROM Teams ORDER BY T DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND firstNHL = '2011'
SELECT CAST(SUM(PPG) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(PPC) FROM Teams GROUP BY tmID ORDER BY SUM(L) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.nameGiven FROM Scoring T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.PIM BETWEEN 200 AND 250 AND T1.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2005 ORDER BY T1.GP DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT award, coachID FROM AwardsCoaches WHERE coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM Coaches ORDER BY w DESC LIMIT 1)

WITH top AS (SELECT tmID, name FROM Teams WHERE year=1915 ORDER BY W DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT V2.oppID) FROM TeamVsTeam V2 WHERE V2.year=1915 AND V2.tmID=top.tmID) AS num_opponents, top.name, O.name
FROM top JOIN TeamVsTeam V ON V.year=1915 AND V.tmID=top.tmID JOIN Teams O ON O.year=1915 AND O.tmID=V.oppID
SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM Teams WHERE year = 2006 AND W > L AND Pts > 100

SELECT A.award, M.nameGiven, M.lastName FROM AwardsPlayers A JOIN Master M ON A.playerID=M.playerID WHERE A.pos=(SELECT pos FROM AwardsPlayers WHERE pos IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pos ORDER BY COUNT(award) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY A.year DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year=1995 AND name IN ('Florida Panthers','Edmonton Oilers','Los Angeles Kings') ORDER BY CAST(PKC AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.rank, T2.year, T2.name FROM Scoring T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T1.SHA >= 7 ORDER BY T1.A DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.W FROM TeamVsTeam T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.year=T2.year AND T1.tmID=T2.tmID WHERE T1.year=1985 AND T1.oppID='BOS' AND T2.name='Philadelphia Flyers'
SELECT T2.PIM FROM Teams T1 JOIN TeamsSC T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T1.name='Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.year=1918
SELECT T2.W FROM TeamsSC T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.year=T2.year AND T1.tmID=T2.tmID WHERE T2.name='Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.PIM=24
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE lastName='Green' AND playerID IS NOT NULL AND coachID IS NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.birthCountry='USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(c.coachID) FROM Master m JOIN Coaches c ON m.coachID=c.coachID JOIN Teams t ON c.year=t.year AND c.tmID=t.tmID WHERE t.name='Montreal Canadiens'
SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.ENG = '10' ORDER BY T2.height DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.tmID) FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON g.playerID=m.playerID WHERE m.lastName='Young'

SELECT SUM(CAST(T2.W AS REAL)/T2.G)/COUNT(T3.oppID) FROM Teams T1 JOIN TeamsSC T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year JOIN TeamVsTeam T3 ON T3.tmID=T1.tmID AND T3.year=T1.year WHERE T1.name='Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT T3.name FROM TeamVsTeam T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.year=T2.year AND T1.tmID=T2.tmID JOIN Teams T3 ON T1.year=T3.year AND T1.oppID=T3.tmID WHERE T2.name='Buffalo Sabres' AND T1.year=2000 GROUP BY T3.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.W+T1.L+IFNULL(T1.T,0)+IFNULL(T1.OTL,0)) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT m.firstName, m.lastName FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON g.playerID=m.playerID WHERE g.tmID='BOS' AND g.year=1972 AND m.coachID IS NOT NULL AND m.hofID IS NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.year = 2005 THEN g.GP ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN g.year = 2006 THEN g.GP ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN g.year = 2005 THEN g.GP ELSE 0 END) FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON g.playerID = m.playerID WHERE m.firstName = 'David' AND m.lastName = 'Aebischer'
SELECT playerID FROM Master GROUP BY playerID HAVING AVG(height) = 75
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(weight AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT T1.playerID FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.year=T2.year AND T1.tmID=T2.tmID WHERE T2.name='Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T1.GA) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT playerID FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NOT NULL AND playerID IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT T2.coachID FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(T2.Pts), T1.coachID FROM Coaches T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T2.tmID='ANA' GROUP BY T1.coachID
SELECT CAST(T1.W AS REAL)/T1.G, T2.playerID FROM Teams T1 JOIN Scoring T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T1.tmID='CAR' AND T1.year=1998 ORDER BY T2.G DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.playerID, T2.tmID FROM (SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE height IS NOT NULL ORDER BY height ASC LIMIT 1) AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT playerID, tmID FROM Scoring WHERE year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936) AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID
SELECT T1.title FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.keyword = 'laundering money'
SELECT COUNT(T2.role) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.season = 9 AND T1.episode = 17 AND T2.credited = 'true'
SELECT c.role FROM Credit c JOIN Person p ON c.person_id=p.person_id JOIN Episode e ON e.episode_id=c.episode_id WHERE p.name='Park Dietz' AND e.title='Cherished' AND c.credited='true'
SELECT c.credited FROM Credit c JOIN Person p ON p.person_id=c.person_id WHERE p.name='Anthony Azzara' AND c.episode_id='tt0629204'
SELECT SUM(V.votes) FROM Episode E JOIN Vote V ON V.episode_id=E.episode_id WHERE E.title='Cherished'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.title = 'Refuge: Part 1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.title = 'Shield' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id
SELECT T2.keyword FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title = 'Shield'
SELECT DISTINCT c.role FROM Credit c JOIN Person p ON c.person_id=p.person_id WHERE p.name='Joseph Blair'
SELECT air_date FROM Episode ORDER BY votes DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.category='Cast' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.episode_id=T2.episode_id WHERE T1.season=9 AND T1.series='Law and Order'
SELECT a.organization FROM Award a JOIN Person p ON a.person_id=p.person_id WHERE p.name='Constantine Makris' AND a.result='Winner' GROUP BY a.organization ORDER BY COUNT(a.award_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T2.person_id) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.episode_id=T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title='Admissions' AND T2.credited='false'
SELECT COUNT(c.role) FROM Credit c JOIN Person p ON p.person_id=c.person_id WHERE p.name='Julia Roberts'
SELECT birth_place, birth_region FROM Person WHERE birth_name = 'Rene Chenevert Balcer'
